name: @stxt-lang/core
description: Parser and schema validator for STXT, an indentation-based structured-text language.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const dir of ['out', 'dist']) require('node:fs').rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && npm run build:bundle
scripts.build:bundle: esbuild src/all.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=StxtCore --target=es2021 --minify --banner:js="/*! @stxt-lang/core | MIT License | https://stxt.dev */" --outfile=dist/stxt-core.js && esbuild src/all.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2021 --minify --banner:js="/*! @stxt-lang/core | MIT License | https://stxt.dev */" --outfile=dist/stxt-core.mjs
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run lint
